intro.text: A Rosharan nation whose lands once belonged to the Silver Kingdom of Makabakam.
A Rosharan nation and a member state of the Azish Empire.

description.text: Deshi travellers were often seen in Yeddaw, in Tashikk. To Lift their clothes looked countrified, in lighter colours, much like what people wear in Alm.
Desh formally recognises the Prime Aqasix as its emperor. In practice it governs itself, but follows Azir's lead in international affairs.
A small nation at the foot of Roshar's western mountains, bordering Azir to the east and Yezier to the south. Mountains separate it from Shinovar to the west and Babatharnam to the north.

items.text: Deshi travellers were often seen in Yeddaw, in Tashikk. To Lift their clothes looked countrified, in lighter colours, much like what people wear in Alm.
Lift once visited Desh and enjoyed it, since few people there tried to kill her.
A Deshi ambassador was in Azimir when Noura told Dalinar that the Azish empire would join his coalition.

told.title: Part of Makabakam
told.text: In the age of the Silver Kingdoms, Desh's lands were part of Makabakam.

told.title: Joining the Azish Empire
told.text: Some time before 1174, Desh became one of the member states of the Azish Empire.

told.title: Lift passes through
told.text: Lift once spent time in Desh and liked it there, since hardly anyone tried to kill her.

told.title: A witness in Azimir
told.text: Desh had an ambassador in Azimir on the day Noura told Dalinar Kholin that the Azish had accepted his invitation to visit Urithiru.
